$comment: Checked-in MCP servers for this repo. context7 needs no credentials. github and databricks require the env vars noted below -- set them in your shell (or .env, never committed) before launching the CLI. MCP is an open standard, so these same servers work in any MCP-capable CLI (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, ...); only the config file location differs per client.

context7.$comment: Live, version-correct docs for the libraries this repo leans on (polars, duckdb, pyspark, sqlglot, dash, databricks-sdk, mlflow). No credentials required.

github.$comment: Issues, PRs, and Actions for the branch->commit->PR->CI flow. Requires GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN (a fine-grained PAT). Alternatively the `gh` CLI (already allowed) covers most of this.

databricks.$comment: Unity Catalog discovery, lineage, and SQL execution for the source-to-target / KPI work. Requires DATABRICKS_HOST and DATABRICKS_TOKEN (or a configured profile in ~/.databrickscfg). This community server is one option; Databricks also ships managed MCP servers governed via Unity AI Gateway -- see https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/generative-ai/mcp/ . Disabled by default until creds are set.
